(()=>{const blobs=new Map();window.__fileProof=[];const create=URL.createObjectURL.bind(URL);URL.createObjectURL=blob=>{const url=create(blob);blobs.set(url,blob);return url};const click=HTMLAnchorElement.prototype.click;HTMLAnchorElement.prototype.click=function(...args){const blob=blobs.get(this.href),name=this.download;if(blob&&name)void blob.arrayBuffer().then(async bytes=>{const arr=new Uint8Array(bytes),sha256=[...new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',arr))].map(b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');let binary='';for(const b of arr)binary+=String.fromCharCode(b);window.__fileProof.push({name,mime:blob.type,bytes:arr.length,sha256,base64:btoa(binary)})});return click.apply(this,args)}})()
